label: On every symmetric frame, actual full-predicate MC is equivalent to necessary full-predicate MC at…
meaning: Stipulated mathematical conditional theorem, not Hume attribution or a metaphysical possibility claim. Compose K successor identity for actual-to-necessary MC. Conversely each accessible successor has MC; its symmetric back-edge to the root and admissible equality identify it with the root. K successor identity then yields actual MC. At a dead end the universal reasoning remains valid without positing a successor.
